The **1967 Federation Cup** was the fifth edition of what is now known as the [Billie Jean King Cup]. 17 nations participated in the tournament, which was held at the Blau-Weiss Tennis Club in [West Berlin] from 6–11 June. [United States] defended their title, defeating [Great Britain] in the final.[[1]]#cite_note-1)
